C003_threeways.outcome: By the end, viewers can name which of the three mistakes is theirs.

slides.head: How does one red block keep beating you in Impact Zero?
Way 1: the edge. You clear the block, clip the corner, run over.
slides.sub: So you give it more room?

slides.head: Way 2: the overcorrect. More room on one side is less on the other.
Way 3: the hesitation. Stop mid-line and the next block is already there.
Commitment. Pick the line, hold it. 35 courses to practice. $2.99 on iPhone.
slides.sub: Comment PLAY for the link. Which of the 3 gets you most?

C003_threeways.caption:
How does one red block keep beating you in Impact Zero? (hard iPhone game)

Three ways. The edge: you clear the block, clip the corner, run over. The overcorrect: more room on one side is less on the other. The hesitation: stop mid-line and the next block is already there.

So what actually works? Commitment. Pick the line and hold it. 35 courses to practice on.

Out now on iPhone for $2.99.
